# 2 Baruch Chapter 47 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 47:1 — object of mourning

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "mourned over-Babylon and-over what-had-happened" |
| LOGOS | "mourned over Babylon and over what had befallen" |
| PNEUMA | "grieved over Babylon and over what had happened" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Befallen' preserves the slightly archaic but contextually appropriate register of the lamentation genre.

---

## 47:2 — prayer address formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "O-LORD, you-who-endure-forever" |
| LOGOS | "O Lord, you who endure forever" |
| PNEUMA | "O Lord, you who endure forever" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA. EMET's hyphenation is the only divergence; the rendering is otherwise agreed.

---
